1.

Sweet moment, when we may sit down Here at Thy feet, beloved Lord! To the green pastures Thou dost lead us, And for us Thou art the fountain of life.

2.

This rest Thou dost gladly grant us Amid the toil, sorrow, and strife of time, Still flow the wells of bliss Of infinite love, grace, and peace.

3.

Thy words strengthen and comfort us, They are light upon this dark earth, Our hearts rejoice when Thou dost speak, And we feel the power of Thy word.

4.

Lord Jesus, enlighten our eyes, That we may see the wonders in Thy word! May Thy Spirit work unhindered, Grant to each one a rich blessing!
